categories.label: Characters
categories.blurb: Commands that act on the selected character or its army.

categories.label: Armies
categories.blurb: Commands that spawn, heal or change the selected army.

categories.label: Settlements
categories.blurb: Commands that act on the selected settlement.

categories.label: Diplomacy
categories.blurb: Force diplomatic states. Plain forms use the selection or a faction key; the "2" forms use the open diplomacy screen.

categories.label: Economy
categories.blurb: Gold, research, resources, technologies and effect bundles for your faction.

categories.label: Events
categories.blurb: Trigger incidents, dilemmas, missions and rituals.

categories.label: Map
categories.blurb: Fog of war, map reveal and map export.

categories.label: Debug
categories.blurb: Info overlays, UI dumps and script execution.

categories.label: Console
categories.blurb: Features of the console itself: chaining, aliases, script files.

commands.summary: Add units to the selected army.
commands.details: Count defaults to 1. Rank is 0 to 9 and only applies to the newly added units.

commands.summary: Raise the experience rank of every unit in the selected army.
commands.details: Ranks defaults to 1.

commands.summary: Give experience points to the selected character.
Set the selected character to an exact rank, lowering it if needed.
commands.details: Skills are kept. Use rank <rank> reset to also reset the skills.

commands.summary: Set the selected character to an exact rank and reset their skills.
commands.details: Same as rank, but the skill points are refunded so they can be spent again.

commands.summary: Add a skill point to the selected character.
commands.details: Adds the point to the character details, so it works for skills the character could not otherwise take.

commands.summary: Send the selected character to limbo.
commands.details: The character disappears from the map. Its position is remembered so unlimbo can bring it back; a character in limbo cannot be selected.

commands.summary: Bring the last character sent to limbo back to its old position.

commands.summary: Remove the huge movement bundle.
Teleport a character.
commands.details: With a settlement open, teleports the selected character next to it. With the army panel open, teleports the previously selected character next to the current one.

commands.summary: Spawn a spawnable force army for your faction next to the selection.
commands.details: Force is a spawnable_forces key. Needs a settlement or the army panel open.

commands.summary: Override the selected settlement's climate, or restore it with reset.
commands.details: Climate is a settlement climate type key. A failed override is logged to the console.

commands.summary: Instantly build a building for free in a numbered slot of the selected settlement.
Advance a lifecycle building in the selected settlement.
commands.details: Without turns it moves to its next stage; with turns it progresses by that many turns.

commands.summary: Finish construction of the foreign slots in the selected settlement.
